name: Spawn of Kyuss
author: Tyler Kamstra
sourceRevision: Printed text mirror of Monstrous Races 2
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for 2014 fifth edition, published on DMs Guild in Monstrous Races 2.
sourceDistinctions: The player worm has no recharge line. A failed save deals 1 piercing immediately. The worm deals 2d6 necrotic at turn end. It has the delayed damage and removal rules in the player block. The encounter-monster spawn effect is absent.

name: Trapper
author: Tyler Kamstra
sourceRevision: Printed text mirror of Monstrous Races 2
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for 2014 fifth edition, published on DMs Guild in Monstrous Races 2.
sourceDistinctions: The trait block gives blindsight 30 ft. The design notes mention darkvision, which this build does not grant. Run Smother as the printed unarmed strike followed by a separate bonus-action grapple on a hit.

name: Vargouille
author: Tyler Kamstra
sourceRevision: Printed text mirror of Monstrous Races 2
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for 2014 fifth edition, published on DMs Guild in Monstrous Races 2.
sourceDistinctions: The ability increase line is blank. The play advice mentions darkvision but the trait block supplies neither the trait nor a range. The action text of Kiss says visible creature within 5 ft. and does not require humanoid or incapacitated; both narrower limits appear in commentary. The NPC rolls against its own Shriek as a table reading of the unqualified creatures in range. Sneak Attack adds piercing for the mixed-type bite in this build.

name: Vegepygmy
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 73, Vegepygmy Traits; p. 89, Vegepygmy Chief feat
sourceRevision: Printed text mirror of Monstrous Races 2
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for 2014 fifth edition, published on DMs Guild in Monstrous Races 2.
sourceDistinctions: The standard and Thorny forms stay in one profile. The optional Vegepygmy Chief feat is on p. 89 and applies to the standard form. The worked Fighter 1 uses the standard form without the feat.

name: Xvart
author: Tyler Kamstra
sourceRevision: Printed text mirror of Monstrous Races 2
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra for 2014 fifth edition, published on DMs Guild in Monstrous Races 2.
sourceDistinctions: The supplement describes the Warlock of Raxivort as ordinary warlock advancement with suggested invocations and no selected patron. The NPC uses Rogue 1 and keeps the species bonus-action Disengage.
